description: Translate the user's base resume, the one saved on their AI Applyd account, into another language (for example Spanish, French, German, Portuguese or Japanese), ready to send to employers in that market. Returns the new resume's title and a link; the translation is saved as a separate resume and the original stays unchanged. Needs a resume on file (see aiapplyd_set_resume) and uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to tailor a resume to a job; use aiapplyd_optimize_resume, or aiapplyd_apply, which tailors every application.
name: aiapplyd_translate_resume
title: Translate Resume
